BIG NEWS from @awscloud and @nvidia 🤝

We're announcing a major expansion of our strategic collaboration for next-gen AI infrastructure. ⬇️

Building on 16 years of joint innovation, AWS will deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across its global infrastructure in 2027–2028—and that's just the start. The two companies are deepening their work together across AI factories, CPUs, networking, open models, data processing, and robotics.

This expansion gives customers even more ways to build and deploy AI at scale. 940+ likes · 1 week ago

Amazon's drones are reinventing what fast means. Here's an inside look at the future of delivery. ⚡

Nearly all items 5 pounds or less that fit in a large shoebox can be delivered ultrafast by drone—we're talking snacks, headphones, last-minute gifts, and more. Our drones use onboard cameras and sensors for navigation, obstacle detection, and safe delivery. Oh, and they're fully electric and can fly in light rain and a range of temperatures. ⬇️ 140+ likes · 3 weeks ago

Before it ever ships, Amazon packaging gets dropped, shaken, squeezed, and slammed in a lab designed to push it to the limit. ⬇️ 

Behind the scenes at Amazon's Packaging Innovation Lab, durability tests help us make sure reduced packaging, easier to recycle materials, and sometimes even the product’s own packaging can protect products during shipping.

✅ Drop tests simulate the bumps of transit
✅ Vibration tables replicate the rumble of road and air transport
✅ Compression machines mimic stacking in a truck 

The result is less material, less waste, and packaging built to go the distance. 100+ likes · 3 weeks ago
